defs.def: to be all around sth/sb 围绕；环绕

ex.s: In addition, there’s no need for pesticides and other chemicals that pollute traditional farms and the surrounding environment.
ex.t: 此外，还不需要杀虫剂和其他污染传统农场及周边环境的化学品。

ex.s: Instead, surround yourself with healthy choices.
ex.t: 相反，让自己周围都是健康的选择。

ex.s: 69   (surround) the mountain tops, he was reduced to tears.
ex.t: 69  （环绕）山顶，他感动得流下了眼泪。

ex.s: The hungry bear followed his nose to our camp，which was surrounded by a high wire fence.
ex.t: 那只饥饿的熊循着气味来到我们的营地，营地四周围着高高的铁丝网。

ex.s: （4）Why do the hikers take no notice of the surroundings during the journey？
ex.t: （4）为什么徒步者在旅途期间对周围的环境毫不在意？

ex.s: He did field research across China and studied more than a thousand rivers and streams, along with the landscape, history and culture of the surrounding areas.
ex.t: 他在中国各地进行了实地研究，研究了1000多条河流和溪流，同时研究了周边地区的景观，历史和文化。

ex.s: Although we are surrounded by reminders of the disaster, we are working together to rebuild our homes and our lives.
ex.t: 尽管我们周围都是灾难的痕迹，我们正齐心协力重建我们的家园和生活。

ex.s: They were called “cloud runners” because it looked like they were floating on a brown cloud of dust as they carved paths through the surrounding fields.
ex.t: 他们被称为“云跑者”，因为当他们穿过周围的田野开辟道路时，看起来就像漂浮在一片棕色的尘土云上。

ex.s: With an average elevation of about 4,000 to 5,000 metres, the Plateau is surrounded by massive mountain ranges.
ex.t: 平均海拔约4,000至5,000米，高原被巨大的山脉环绕。

defs.def: to move into position all around sb/sth, especially so as to prevent them from escaping; to move sb/sth into position in this way 包围；围住

ex.s: Truly this water which surrounded me was but another air heavier than the Earth’s atmosphere, but almost as clear.
ex.t: 确实，包围着我的水不过是另一种比地球大气更重的空气，但几乎同样清澈。

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Soil surrounding the sequoia in its original location was relocated as well, because trees are more likely to survive a transplant when they move with their original soil.
ex.t: 红杉原址周围的土壤也一并迁移，因为带着原土移植，树更可能存活。

defs.def: to be closely connected with sth/sb 与 … 紧密相关；围绕
to choose to have particular people or things near you all the time 喜欢结交（某类人）；喜欢身边总有（某类东西）

ex.s: If you’re among the groups of people who are enjoying the mental and physical health benefits of surrounding yourself with plants, don’t beat yourself up if one (or a few!) doesn’t make it.
ex.t: 如果你属于那些享受与植物为伴带来的身心健康益处的人群，不要因为一两棵植物没养活而自责。

ex.s: We’ve all been there: in a lift, in line at the bank or on an airplane, surrounded by people who are, like us, deeply focused on their smartphones or, worse, struggling with the uncomfortable silence.
ex.t: 我们都经历过这样的情况：在电梯里、在银行排队或在飞机上，周围的人像我们一样全神贯注地看着智能手机，或者更糟的是，在不舒服的沉默中挣扎。
